content:
Overview

South Portland is a city in ME with a population of 26,000. Coastal city across the harbor from Portland with beaches and working waterfront. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
